authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9964 mahiṣa gives regional mhes/mɔĩś buffalo, Hindi mhaĩs and neighboring maĩś forms. Goj mes/mēs, Kaithal mẽs and Hajong moiś are compared with this buffalo family; vowel, sibilant, nasal and aspiration details remain explicit and intra-Indo-Aryan transmission is open. Exact survey form mes is preserved.
